description: Checks for new Red Code builds, downloads the installer, verifies its SHA-256 and keeps a local version history.
repositoryDescription: GitHub repository (`owner/name`) that publishes Red Code releases. Releases must contain `RedCode-Setup.exe` and, preferably, a `redcode-updates.json` manifest with the installer SHA-256.
feedUrlDescription: HTTPS URL of a custom update feed. When set, it takes precedence over the GitHub repository.
checkOnStartupDescription: Check for updates once after startup. The result is cached for six hours; checks never block the editor.
prereleaseDescription: Also offer GitHub releases marked as pre-release.
downloadDirectoryDescription: Where installers are downloaded. Empty uses the system temporary directory.
installArgumentsDescription: Arguments passed to the Inno Setup installer. The default installs silently, does not restart Windows and does not launch Red Code afterwards.
